description: City of Toronto publishes point locations of all schools known to the city, including private schools "to the best of our knowledge", as GeoJSON, GeoPackage, CSV and zipped files in several coordinate systems (the file names carry the codes 4326, 2952 and 2945). Coverage: the City of Toronto; the portal states updates "as available" and the record was last modified on 2026-05-27. Format and access: GeoJSON, GeoPackage, CSV, downloadable without registration from the City of Toronto Open Data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Open Government Licence - Toronto, as shown on the dataset page (the CKAN API licence field reads "License not specified"); cost: free. Caveats: the private schools are listed on a best-knowledge basis and the file contains locations without enrolment or capacity; the CKAN API licence field does not carry the Open Government Licence - Toronto shown on the pages; the files were not opened. Simulation uses: schools as shelters and critical facilities in flood and emergency-response models, and for catchment accessibility analysis. Related catalogue records: Urban Form Toronto: built environment and walkability measures on a 100 m hexagon grid (data-toronto-urban-form-hex-measures); City of Toronto watermain breaks 1990 to 2016 (data-toronto-watermain-breaks); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
